title: Traffic Shift Tactician - Weekly Deployment Manifest (Feb 2027) - WIP
content:
Purpose:
This working manifest is a compact, tactical playbook for the Feb 2027 weekly deployment slot. Focus: small surface-area changes to routing + a model variant flip for hosted API. Primary goal: validate canary metrics and sanity-check KV cache behavior under realistic traffic. Secondary goal: exercise new throttling guardrail in Dedicated autoscaler.

Summary of change:
- Deploy PR 987 (serving-runtime): adaptive-throttle + circuit signal for slow-kv-cache paths
- Roll model 3.1.2 -> 3.2.0-quant for low-latency tier only
- Enable prefetched-prefix caching for 20% of requests in EU region only (feature-flagged)

Quick anchor: if any SLO breach (p50 latency > 120ms sustained for 3m, error rate > 0.8%) -> immediate rollback to previous model and throttle change.

Preflight checklist (must be green before traffic shift):
- [ ] All CI checks pass on PR 987 (unit, integration, perf)
- [ ] Canary infra provisioned (one dedicated pool: 4xA10g for EU-test)
- [ ] Observability dashboards pinned and baseline snapshots captured (Grafana "TS-2027-02 baseline")
- [ ] Smoke harness can call /health + sample text generation end-to-end
- [ ] Chaos tests disabled for rollout window (ticket: RELEASE-3124)
- [ ] Slack rotation set: #release-ops (ops lead), #sre (oncall), #hosting (infra)
- [ ] Pager duty escalation tested and PD rotation confirmed for the window
- [ ] RBAC/Secrets: KMS key rotation not scheduled during rollout; keys validated

Traffic-shift plan (granular):
- T+00:00 Start window: 02-12-2027 09:00 UTC (2 hours)
- T+00:05 Deploy runtime PR into canary workers (EU-only)
- T+00:10 Enable model 3.2.0-quant variant gate for 1% traffic -> smoke test generator 200 reqs
- T+00:20 Increase to 5% if no alerts
- T+00:40 Increase to 20% (prefetch caching enabled only for EU-canary)
- T+01:10 Observe for 30m; if stable, schedule A/B sample groups to 50% (if A/B gating enabled)
- T+01:40 Progressive step to 80% if all checks green; final cutover to 100% will be manual sign-off and done only after customer notify window (not in this week)

Owner assignments (names + backup):
- Release conductor: Aisha Patel (backup: Marco Liu)
- SRE leads: Priya Singh (backup: Evan Gomez)
- Observability: Marco Liu (dashboard and alert tuning)
- Customer comms: Lynn Carter (pre-draft release note in #cs-drafts)
- DB/Cache SME: Raul Mendes (standby 09:00-12:00 UTC)

Rollout calendar (compact):
- 2027-02-12 07:00 UTC: Final preflight check-in (15m) - all leads
- 2027-02-12 09:00 UTC: Window open - start canary deploy
- 2027-02-12 09:45 UTC: Readout checkpoint 1 - p50/p95, error rate, kv-cache hit-rate
- 2027-02-12 10:30 UTC: Readout checkpoint 2 - autoscaler behavior, GPU utilization
- 2027-02-12 11:15 UTC: Decision point - continue progressive steps or rollback
- 2027-02-12 12:00 UTC: Window close - store artifacts, debrief notes

Guardrails & quick checks (operational knobs):
- Abort thresholds: p50 > 120ms for 3m OR error rate > 0.8% OR GPU OOMs observed
- Auto-retry disabled for canary to avoid masking errors
- Throttle knob: max_rps_per_worker reduced to 80% of baseline during canary
- Fallback policy: route to fallback-model-v3.1.2 if any cache-induced errors

Rollback matrix (fast action):
- Symptoms: sustained latency spike (p50 >120ms) -> Action: set routing weight model->previous 100%, rollback runtime change (PR 987 revert) -> notify channels -> postmortem flag
- Symptoms: errors spiking (>=0.8%) -> Action: immediate 0% traffic to new model, disable prefetch caching, revert autoscaler change
- Symptoms: KV cache corruption signs (mismatched outputs or cache hit anomalies) -> Action: isolate cache pool, switch canary pool to read-only, manual cache purge + sanity checks

Manual comm templates (short):
- Slack (incident): "[ROLLBACK] TS-2027-02: initiating rollback of model 3.2.0-quant and runtime PR 987 due to latency spike. More info in thread; oncall: @Priya"
- Status page blip: "We are investigating elevated latencies for text-generation in EU. Service impact is limited; a rollback has been initiated to restore normal service."
- Internal async readout (end-window): "Canary result: p50 +7ms vs baseline; p95 -3ms; kv-cache hit-rate +4pct. Decision: continue staged rollout next week after performance regression test. Artifacts: link to grafana snapshot + CI link."

Relnotes draft (internal; short):
- Title: "runtime: adaptive throttle + prefix-prefetch (canary)"
- Blurb: "This release enables an adaptive throttling signal to reduce tail-latency for slow kv cache paths and turns on prefix-prefetch in EU canary. Expect lower p95 on heavy tail requests; validated on small population."
- Breaking changes: "None. Feature gated; default behavior unchanged."
- Known issues: "On very low-volume clients, prefetch may increase cold-start latency for the first request. We're tracking via RELEASE-3135."

Telemetry queries to run (examples):
- p50/p95 generation latency by model variant - query: gen.latency_ms{model:3.2.0-quant,region:eu}
- KV cache hit-rate / miss-rate - query: cache.kv.hit_rate{pool:eu-canary}
- Error grouping by stack - query: errors.count by (exception)
- Autoscaler up/down events - query: infra.autoscaler.events{pool:dedicated-eu}
- Token cost per request by model - query: billing.token_cost{model_variant}
Open tickets & PRs (snapshot):
- JIRA RELEASE-3124: "Canary window scheduling + comms" (owner: Aisha)
- JIRA RELEASE-3135: "prefetch cold-start regression" (owner: Raul)
- PR github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/987 (adaptive-throttle)
- PR github.com/redwood/model-registry/pull/451 (3.2.0-quant bundle)

Notes to self / loose thoughts (scratch):
- If autoscaler shows oscillation at 20% traffic, try reducing scale-up sensitivity to 15s from 30s for the canary pool only
- Consider a secondary small-burst test (1000 requests/s for 60s) on canary to exercise caching logic under heat
- Post-release: schedule a light-weight perf-run against 3.2.0-quant in sandbox with longer context (>1024)

Postmortem / artifacts collection checklist (end of window):
- [ ] Save Grafana snapshots (baseline and during canary)
- [ ] Export sampling traces to S3: s3://release-artifacts/TS-2027-02
- [ ] Attach CI pipeline output and perf-run logs to JIRA RELEASE-3124
- [ ] Short debrief email to #release-ops with final decisions and next steps

Appendix: quick runbook commands
- Set routing weight to previous model: curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/weights -d '{"model":"3.1.2","weight":1.0}' (ops token required)
- Disable prefetch flag: gcloud runtime-flags set prefetch_prefix_eu=false --project=prod
- Revert PR locally: git revert --no-commit origin/pr/987 && ./deploy-script canary

End of manifest.

-- draft v0.3 --
